1.text: Bana, mujye mwumvira ababyeyi banyu mu Mwami wacu, kuko ari byo bibakwiriye.

2.text: Wubahe so na nyoko (iryo ni ryo tegeko rya mbere ririmo isezerano),

3.text: kugira ngo ubone amahoro uramire mu isi.

4.text: Namwe ba se ntimugasharirire abana banyu, ahubwo mubarere mubahana, mubigisha iby'Umwami wacu.

5.text: Namwe mbata, mujye mwumvira ba shobuja bo ku mubiri nk'uko mwumvira Kristo, mububashye muhinda imishyitsi kandi mutaryarya mu mitima yanyu.

6.text: Ntimukabakorere bakibahagarikiye gusa ngo mumere nk'abanezeza abantu, ahubwo mumere nk'imbata za Kristo, mukore ibyo Imana ishaka mubikuye ku mutima.

7.text: Mubakorere mubyishimiye nk'abakorera Umwami wacu, mutari nk'abakorera abantu.

8.text: Kuko muzi yuko umuntu wese iyo akoze ikintu cyiza azacyiturwa n'Umwami, naho yaba imbata cyangwa uw'umudendezo.

9.text: Namwe ba shebuja, abe ari ko mugirira abagaragu banyu namwe, mureke kubakangisha kuko muzi yuko musangiye Shobuja uri mu ijuru, utarobanura abantu ku butoni.

10.text: Ibisigaye mukomerere mu Mwami no mu mbaraga z'ubushobozi bwe bwinshi.

11.text: Mwambare intwaro zose z'Imana, kugira ngo mubashe guhagarara mudatsinzwe n'uburiganya bwa Satani.

12.text: Kuko tudakīrana n'abafite amaraso n'umubiri, ahubwo dukīrana n'abatware n'abafite ubushobozi n'abategeka iyi si y'umwijima, n'imyuka mibi y'ahantu ho mu ijuru.

13.text: Nuko rero mutware intwaro zose z'Imana, kugira ngo mubashe gukomera ku munsi mubi, kandi murangije byose mubashe guhagarara mudatsinzwe.

14.text: Muhagarare mushikamye mukenyeye ukuri, mwambaye gukiranuka nk'icyuma gikingira igituza,

15.text: mukwese inkweto, ari zo butumwa bwiza bw'amahoro bubiteguza,

16.text: kandi ikigeretse kuri byose mutware kwizera nk'ingabo, ari ko muzashoboza kuzimisha imyambi ya wa mubi yose yaka umuriro.

17.text: Mwakire agakiza kabe ingofero, mwakire n'inkota y'Umwuka ari yo Jambo ry'Imana,

18.text: musengeshe Umwuka iteka mu buryo bwose bwo gusenga no kwinginga, kandi ku bw'ibyo mugumye rwose kuba maso, musabire abera bose.

19.text: Kandi nanjye munsabire mpabwe kuvuga nshize amanga uko mbumbuye akanwa, kugira ngo menyeshe abantu ubwiru bw'ubutumwa bwiza,

20.text: ari bwo mbereye intumwa yabwo kandi mbohesherejwe umunyururu, mvuge ibyabwo nshize amanga nk'uko binkwiriye.

21.text: Kandi Tukiko, mwene Data ukundwa w'umubwiriza w'iby'Imana ukiranuka ukorera mu Mwami, azabasobanurira byose kugira ngo namwe mumenye ibyanjye uko meze.

22.text: Ni we mwatumyeho ku bw'ibyo ngo mumenye ibyacu, kandi ahumurize imitima yanyu.

23.text: Amahoro abe muri bene Data, n'urukundo rufatanije no kwizera, biva ku Mana Data wa twese no ku Mwami Yesu Kristo.

24.text: Ubuntu bw'Imana bubane n'abakunda Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo bose bataryarya.
